findings.highlight: I’d be really dishonest if I don’t go
findings.evidenceJa: 公園で待っていないと不義理すぎる
findings.governingReading: it would be far too discourteous not to wait for her in the park
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes failure to honor an informal social obligation into dishonesty and omits the appointed place and act of waiting.

findings.highlight: Going to buy stuff for dinner
findings.evidenceJa: 夕飯のおかずを買ってくる
findings.governingReading: going to buy side dishes or ingredients for dinner
findings.explanation: Shirou’s plausible household errand becomes unspecified “stuff.”

findings.highlight: they shouldn’t be too worried
findings.evidenceJa: 二人もそう驚かないだろう
findings.governingReading: the two probably will not be very surprised
findings.explanation: The expected reaction changes from surprise at his absence to worry about his safety.

findings.highlight: Even with the apartments looming overhead
findings.evidenceJa: まわりを団地でかこまれた小さな公園は寂しく
findings.governingReading: the small park enclosed by apartment blocks feels lonely
findings.explanation: The English omits the park’s size and loneliness and invents apartments looming overhead.

findings.highlight: the dark sky
findings.evidenceJa: 曇った空
findings.governingReading: the overcast sky
findings.explanation: Cloud cover becomes darkness, changing the time-of-day impression.

findings.highlight: the gift
findings.evidenceJa: ちょっとしたお土産
findings.governingReading: a little gift or token
findings.explanation: The modest scale of Shirou’s offering disappears.

findings.highlight: The cold, dry air is freezing
findings.evidenceJa: 冷たく乾燥した空気は張り詰めていて
findings.governingReading: the cold, dry air is taut and still
findings.explanation: Atmospheric tension becomes a redundant temperature statement.

findings.highlight: I have to leave now if I’m going to be home in time
findings.evidenceJa: そろそろ戻らないと嘘つきさんになってしまう
findings.governingReading: if I do not head back soon, I will become a little liar
findings.explanation: mirror moon preserves the deadline but drops Shirou’s playful self-reproach about his written promise.

findings.highlight: My legs freeze
findings.evidenceJa: 前に出した足が、凍りつく
findings.governingReading: the foot he put forward freezes in place
findings.explanation: A single interrupted step becomes paralysis of both legs from the outset.

findings.highlight: My vision blurs. No, that’s an understatement. My vision is broken
findings.evidenceJa: 視界が歪む。いや、歪んだなんてもんじゃない。視覚が壊れた
findings.governingReading: his field of vision distorts, then proves not merely distorted but broken
findings.explanation: The escalation begins from ordinary blur rather than warped spatial perception.

findings.highlight: My eyes have bulged into my skull
findings.evidenceJa: 眼球が頭蓋骨の中に落ち込んで
findings.governingReading: his eyeballs seem to sink or fall back into his skull
findings.explanation: The eye movement is rendered with a verb that means protruding, reversing the bodily image.

findings.highlight: I have no sense of distance
findings.evidenceJa: 自分と周りの距離感が把握できない
findings.governingReading: he cannot grasp the distance between himself and his surroundings
findings.explanation: A relational collapse of bodily position becomes generic poor depth perception.

findings.highlight: my body has been turned into stone
findings.evidenceJa: 体は中身そのものが石になったかのよう
findings.governingReading: it is as though the very contents of his body have become stone
findings.explanation: The source locates petrification inside the body; the English literalizes the entire body as stone.

findings.highlight: leaving me detached from the world
findings.evidenceJa: 視覚さえ“世界”と切り離されていく
findings.governingReading: even his vision is being severed from the world
findings.explanation: The specific progressive failure of visual connection becomes general personal detachment.

findings.highlight: controlling myself in a video game
findings.evidenceJa: コントローラーで操るゲームの主人公になったようで
findings.governingReading: like becoming the protagonist of a game manipulated with a controller
findings.explanation: Shirou experiences loss of agency as a controlled avatar; mirror moon makes him the controller.

findings.highlight: controlling myself in a video game
findings.evidenceJa: 吐き気がする
findings.governingReading: it makes him nauseated
findings.explanation: The physical revulsion closing the perception analogy disappears.

findings.highlight: I can’t even see my attacker’s face, let alone move, and
findings.evidenceJa: 相手の顔さえ見れずにここで
findings.governingReading: unable even to see the attacker’s face, he is about to die here before Illya interrupts
findings.explanation: The English leaves a dangling conjunction but drops the threatened end of Shirou’s interrupted sentence.

findings.highlight: so I had to tease you
findings.evidenceJa: 面白いから、ちょっとからかっちゃった
findings.governingReading: because it looked fun, I teased you a little
findings.explanation: Illya’s mischievous choice becomes an unexplained compulsion.

findings.highlight: being teased by this mischievous girl
findings.evidenceJa: いたずらっ子のオモチャにされていた
findings.governingReading: he has been made a mischievous child’s toy
findings.explanation: The objectification at the punch line is reduced to generic teasing.

findings.highlight: contacting you through vision isn’t that strong
findings.evidenceJa: 視線だけの接触じゃ弾かれちゃうか
findings.governingReading: contact through gaze alone gets repelled
findings.explanation: A specific failure mechanism becomes a vague statement about strength.

findings.highlight: She appears from behind me
findings.evidenceJa: ぴょこり、と後ろから現れる
findings.governingReading: Illya pops lightly into view from behind him
findings.explanation: The childlike physical flourish of her reveal disappears.

findings.highlight: smiling, probably because she was already here and was watching me from behind
findings.evidenceJa: 数分前から公園にいて、面白そうだから俺の後ろをとって様子を見ていた、というにんまりぶり
findings.governingReading: her broad grin says she had been in the park for several minutes and took position behind him to watch because it looked amusing
findings.explanation: The English drops the duration, her deliberate positioning, and the grin as readable evidence of motive.

findings.highlight: can’t dispel magic using your own powers
findings.evidenceJa: 内界だけで解呪できない
findings.governingReading: cannot break the curse from within his inner world alone
findings.explanation: A technical locus of resistance becomes generic personal power.

findings.highlight: outside factors are the only things that can dispel you
findings.evidenceJa: 外部からの影響がないと自分に戻れない
findings.governingReading: cannot return to himself without an outside influence
findings.explanation: Restoration of Shirou’s self is recast as an external force dispelling him as though he were the spell.

findings.highlight: She lectures me
findings.evidenceJa: ふふーん、と偉そうに講義する
findings.governingReading: Illya lectures him with a smug, self-important flourish
findings.explanation: The narration loses the childlike performance under her authority.

findings.highlight: her words aren’t coming into my brain
findings.evidenceJa: そんな戯言はもちろん耳に入ってこない
findings.governingReading: of course none of that nonsense reaches his ears
findings.explanation: The idiom becomes malformed literal anatomy and omits Shirou dismissing her lecture as nonsense.

findings.highlight: I was sitting next to you for a while
findings.evidenceJa: さっきからちゃんと隣にいたもん
findings.governingReading: I was properly beside you all along
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents that Illya was sitting and weakens her insistence that she had been there from before.

findings.highlight: you made it worse by getting ready to leave
findings.evidenceJa: おまけにそのまま帰ろうとするし
findings.governingReading: on top of that, he tried simply to leave
findings.explanation: Her accumulating complaint becomes a causal claim that leaving worsened something unspecified.

findings.highlight: a spell that merely uses direct magical energy contact
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力をぶつけただけの呪縛
findings.governingReading: a binding produced merely by striking him with magical energy
findings.explanation: The English invents direct contact and generalizes the technique from binding to a spell.

findings.highlight: Illya warns me, utterly amazed
findings.evidenceJa: 呆れた風にイリヤは注意してくる
findings.governingReading: Illya admonishes him with an exasperated air
findings.explanation: Her teacherly exasperation becomes astonishment.

findings.highlight: Ohyeah. You’re right
findings.evidenceJa: あうん。それは、そうか
findings.governingReading: Uh—yeah. I suppose that is true
findings.explanation: mirror moon fuses the faltering interjection into malformed English and makes Shirou’s concession more direct.

findings.highlight: it was an official promise
findings.evidenceJa: 確かな約束じゃなかった
findings.governingReading: it was not a firm or definite promise
findings.explanation: The qualification concerns certainty, not formal status.

findings.highlight: That’s your choice
findings.evidenceJa: それはイリヤの事情だろ
findings.governingReading: those are Illya’s circumstances or side of the matter
findings.explanation: Shirou distinguishes their respective positions; mirror moon turns Illya’s threat into a free choice.

findings.highlight: I just want to talk to you, not fight
findings.evidenceJa: マスターじゃないイリヤと話したい
findings.governingReading: he wants to talk with Illya when she is not acting as a Master
findings.explanation: The distinction between Illya’s personal and Master roles becomes a generic preference for conversation over combat.

findings.highlight: Masters don’t fight during daytime, right?
findings.evidenceJa: 昼間戦わないのがマスターなんだろ
findings.governingReading: Masters are supposed not to fight in daytime, as Shirou understands it
findings.explanation: A convention Shirou invokes tentatively is made a categorical rule.

findings.highlight: Do you want to kill me more
findings.evidenceJa: 殺し合いの方が好きなのか
findings.governingReading: does she prefer killing each other
findings.explanation: mirror moon removes the reciprocal combat from Shirou’s deliberately stark choice.

findings.highlight: I have to do both
findings.evidenceJa: わたし、どっちもいっぱいだもの
findings.governingReading: both feelings are full inside her
findings.explanation: Illya describes simultaneous emotional abundance; the English substitutes an external-sounding obligation to perform both acts.

findings.highlight: mumbles
findings.evidenceJa: 言葉を濁す
findings.governingReading: speaks evasively or lets the answer trail off
findings.explanation: Her reluctance to articulate the conflict becomes a vocal-volume description.

findings.highlight: Then I don’t care
findings.evidenceJa: ならどっちでもいいよ
findings.governingReading: then either one is fine
findings.explanation: Shirou’s acceptance of both sides reads as emotional indifference.

findings.highlight: I brought a gift for you today
findings.evidenceJa: お土産もあるし
findings.governingReading: he has a gift as another reason to talk now
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds “today,” slightly sharpening a contrast the source does not state.

findings.highlight: I hold out the taiyaki
findings.evidenceJa: たい焼きを押し付ける
findings.governingReading: he presses the taiyaki on her
findings.explanation: The playful insistence of the peace offering becomes a neutral presentation.

findings.highlight: takes them and nods
findings.evidenceJa: 黙ってたい焼きを手にとって、うん、と小さく頷いてくれた
findings.governingReading: silently takes the taiyaki and gives him a small affirmative nod
findings.explanation: Illya’s quiet hesitation and the smallness of her assent are flattened.

findings.highlight: meaningless things
findings.evidenceJa: 他愛もない話
findings.governingReading: innocent, trivial conversation
findings.explanation: The English calls the ordinary intimacy meaningless rather than inconsequential.

findings.highlight: her maids
findings.evidenceJa: 口うるさいお目付け役のメイド
findings.governingReading: her fussy, supervisory maid
findings.explanation: A singular maid with a specific watchdog role becomes both maids collectively.

findings.highlight: she doesn’t like her maids but wants to like them
findings.evidenceJa: 嫌いだけど好きになってあげてもいい
findings.governingReading: she dislikes the maid but might graciously allow herself to like her
findings.explanation: Illya’s imperious, childlike concession becomes a sincere wish to improve her feelings toward the maids.

findings.highlight: eating the taiyaki
findings.evidenceJa: ちょっとだけ温かいたい焼きをほおばりながら
findings.governingReading: stuffing her cheeks with the still slightly warm taiyaki
findings.explanation: The food’s remaining warmth and Illya’s childlike manner of eating disappear.

findings.highlight: She looks like a child waiting for her father’s return
findings.evidenceJa: そんな姿を想像させた
findings.governingReading: the sight makes Shirou imagine a child waiting for her father to return
findings.explanation: A private association prompted in Shirou becomes a direct visual identification.

findings.highlight: people to take care of my place
findings.evidenceJa: 身の回りの世話をする人
findings.governingReading: people to attend to her personal needs
findings.explanation: Care of Illya herself becomes care of her residence.

findings.highlight: Are they staying at a hotel or something?
findings.evidenceJa: メイドさんを連れたままホテルかどこかに泊まっているんだろうか
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether Illya is staying at a hotel or somewhere with the maids
findings.explanation: The pronoun makes the maids the apparent lodging subject and weakens that this is speculation about Illya’s residence.

findings.highlight: I won’t be able to if I don’t know that
findings.evidenceJa: 場所が判らないのでは駆けつけられない
findings.governingReading: without knowing the place, he could not rush to her aid
findings.explanation: The concrete rescue action and destination collapse into an incomplete generic inability.

findings.highlight: You’ll enter some other place
findings.evidenceJa: 違うものに入っちゃう
findings.governingReading: he may enter the wrong thing or object
findings.explanation: The danger concerns transfer into an unintended vessel, not movement to another location.

findings.highlight: you’ll get motion sickness because the view is someone else’s
findings.evidenceJa: シロウがここにいるかぎり乗り物酔いをしかねない
findings.governingReading: because the viewpoint belongs to another while Shirou remains here, he may suffer motion sickness
findings.explanation: The explanation loses his body’s continued location and reduces a risk to certainty.

findings.highlight: I’m surprised, but I close my eyes
findings.evidenceJa: 驚きで目蓋を閉じる
findings.governingReading: surprise makes his eyelids close
findings.explanation: An involuntary reaction becomes a deliberate action performed despite surprise.

findings.highlight: I’m looking down at an unfamiliar scene
findings.evidenceJa: さも当然のように、高いところから俯瞰している
findings.governingReading: he surveys it from high above as though this were perfectly natural
findings.explanation: The uncanny naturalness and elevated viewpoint of the borrowed vision are reduced.

findings.highlight: I transferred your vision to my forest
findings.evidenceJa: 視覚だけをわたしの森に繋げた
findings.governingReading: she connected only Shirou’s vision to her forest
findings.explanation: The explanation describes a connection, anticipating rerouted input; mirror moon calls it transfer outright.

findings.highlight: Illya’s voice echoes in my head
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤの声が響く
findings.governingReading: Illya’s voice echoes
findings.explanation: The English locates the voice inside Shirou’s head without source support.

findings.highlight: This “vision” is the only thing allowed for me
findings.evidenceJa: 今の俺にあるのは、この“視覚”だけだった
findings.governingReading: this vision is all he presently possesses
findings.explanation: A statement about remaining subjective experience becomes an unexplained permission or restriction.

findings.highlight: My body has been turned into a tree in an instant
findings.evidenceJa: 俺は一瞬にして、物言わぬ木になってしまった
findings.governingReading: he himself has in an instant become a speechless tree
findings.explanation: mirror moon introduces physical transformation of the body, which Illya’s later explanation explicitly denies.

findings.highlight: My vision is the only sense I have
findings.evidenceJa: 自分という容器の感覚が途絶えたまま、視覚だけが生きている
findings.governingReading: with sensation of the vessel that is his body still cut off, only vision remains alive
findings.explanation: The English gives the result but omits the body-as-container model and continuing severance.

findings.highlight: I’m to dress Illya with Heavens Feel, the third dress
findings.evidenceJa: 三番目のドレスを、イリヤに着せる、役
findings.governingReading: her role is to put the third Dress, ruby-glossed Heaven’s Feel, on Illya
findings.explanation: The layered term is recast as though Heaven’s Feel were an ordinary garment used to dress Illya.

findings.highlight: So I don’t like it
findings.evidenceJa: あまり、着せたくない
findings.governingReading: she does not much want to make Illya wear it
findings.explanation: Leysritt’s reluctance to perform the act becomes a vague dislike of an unspecified object or situation.

findings.highlight: we need her to wear it when the time comes
findings.evidenceJa: 時が来れば嫌でも着ていただかなくてはなりません
findings.governingReading: when the time comes, they must have her wear it even against her wishes
findings.explanation: Sella’s explicit willingness to override Illya’s aversion disappears.

findings.highlight: She must be prepared as well
findings.evidenceJa: 既に覚悟はできている筈です
findings.governingReading: Illya should already have steeled or resigned herself to it
findings.explanation: Emotional resolve before an unwanted fate becomes generic preparation.

findings.highlight: I finally return to my body
findings.evidenceJa: 体が元に戻ってくれた
findings.governingReading: his body finally returns to normal for him
findings.explanation: The English makes consciousness travel back into a body rather than describing restoration of bodily self-experience.

findings.highlight: How was it?
findings.evidenceJa: ごくろうさま
findings.governingReading: good work or well done
findings.explanation: Illya’s teasing acknowledgment of Shirou enduring the demonstration is omitted.

findings.highlight: That was some great transformation magic, right?
findings.evidenceJa: ちょっとした変身魔術だったでしょ
findings.governingReading: that was a little bit of transformation magecraft, was it not
findings.explanation: Illya’s playful understatement becomes praise for the feat’s greatness.

findings.highlight: suddenly feeling the realism of my body
findings.evidenceJa: 唐突に“自分”に戻った映像が、今は妙にリアルに感じられて
findings.governingReading: the image that abruptly returned to his own viewpoint now feels strangely real
findings.explanation: The nausea-producing visual readjustment becomes an abstract sensation that his body is realistic.

findings.highlight: I thought you were dense, but you’re actually pretty bright
findings.evidenceJa: 物分り悪そうで鋭いのね
findings.governingReading: you look slow on the uptake, yet you are perceptive
findings.explanation: Illya’s present teasing appraisal becomes a correction of a prior belief and generic intelligence praise.

findings.highlight: still in the realms of magic
findings.evidenceJa: まだ魔術の域でしょ
findings.governingReading: still within the domain of magecraft
findings.explanation: The work’s technical category is rendered as generic magic.

findings.highlight: when you transferred me to the tree
findings.evidenceJa: 木に視覚を移されただけで
findings.governingReading: when only his sight was transferred to the tree
findings.explanation: mirror moon again describes Shirou himself as transferred, erasing the mechanism he is evaluating.

findings.highlight: without diluting its purity
findings.evidenceJa: いつまでも純度を保っていられる
findings.governingReading: can preserve its purity indefinitely
findings.explanation: mirror moon retains purity but drops the defining duration of Tohsaka gem storage.

findings.highlight: they can also transfer someone’s consciousness
findings.evidenceJa: 他人の意識を力技で転移する
findings.governingReading: they can forcibly transfer another person’s consciousness
findings.explanation: The coercive, brute-force character of the offensive application disappears.

findings.highlight: transferring his consciousness into a jewel or an immobile doll
findings.evidenceJa: 意識の入力先を宝石の中とか、身動きできない人形の中に替えて
findings.governingReading: switching the destination of the consciousness’s input to a jewel or an immobile doll
findings.explanation: The source carefully describes rerouted input; mirror moon turns it into wholesale movement of consciousness.

findings.highlight: even we, the ones specialized in transfer
findings.evidenceJa: 転移を得意とするわたしや遠坂の魔術師でさえ
findings.governingReading: even Illya and Tohsaka magi, specialists in transfer
findings.explanation: The named comparison between two magical traditions is reduced to an unclear “we.”

findings.highlight: The body will call its consciousness back when it senses danger
findings.evidenceJa: 肉体が危険を感じて“離れている”意識を呼び戻す
findings.governingReading: the body senses danger and recalls the consciousness that is away from it
findings.explanation: The English preserves recall but drops the physically separated state central to the model.

findings.highlight: your mind was in the tree
findings.evidenceJa: 意識は木を被ってる間
findings.governingReading: while Shirou’s consciousness was wearing the tree as an overlay
findings.explanation: The vivid model of consciousness covered by an external viewpoint becomes simple containment.

findings.highlight: your body called you back
findings.evidenceJa: 体の方が魂を呼び戻した
findings.governingReading: the body called back the soul, ruby-read as Shirou
findings.explanation: mirror moon removes the deliberate identity among soul and Shirou in Illya’s formulation.

findings.highlight: the body wakes up out of habit
findings.evidenceJa: 肉体による習慣的な機能
findings.governingReading: a habitual function performed by the body
findings.explanation: The source distinguishes bodily routine from voluntary waking; the English personifies the body and blurs the mechanism.

findings.highlight: wake up from a dream using your will
findings.evidenceJa: 理性で目覚められる
findings.governingReading: wake properly from a dream through reason
findings.explanation: Illya corrects Shirou by invoking rational awareness, not willpower.

findings.highlight: It’s more for self-protection
findings.evidenceJa: 自分にかける自己保身のための魔術
findings.governingReading: magecraft cast on oneself for self-preservation
findings.explanation: The English loses both the self-targeting constraint and the technical category.

findings.highlight: you can safely pursue magic
findings.evidenceJa: その体を動かして、安全に魔道の探求を行える
findings.governingReading: one can operate that body and safely pursue the path of magecraft
findings.explanation: The reason a familiar or movable doll enables safe research—the caster can move its body—is omitted.

findings.highlight: your familiar
findings.evidenceJa: リモコンロボットである使い魔
findings.governingReading: a familiar functioning as a remote-controlled robot
findings.explanation: Shirou’s concrete model of the controllable proxy disappears.

findings.highlight: hide their original bodies in a safe place
findings.evidenceJa: 絶対安全な場所に隠す
findings.governingReading: hide the original body in an absolutely safe place
findings.explanation: The absolute requirement attached to the caster’s protection is weakened.

findings.highlight: you need to watch out when you transfer into a familiar with its own soul
findings.evidenceJa: 注意すべきは『使い魔』の中でも『魂のある使い魔』への転移の場合ね
findings.governingReading: the case requiring attention is transfer into an ensouled familiar
findings.explanation: A technical exception is phrased as personal advice and the defined class relation is loosened.

findings.highlight: something with a proper chain of command
findings.evidenceJa: ちゃんとした命令系統理性を持っているモノ
findings.governingReading: a being with a proper rational or command faculty
findings.explanation: mirror moon literalizes the surface command-system wording and loses the ruby reading 理性, producing an organizational chain of command.

findings.highlight: the initiative is completely held by them
findings.evidenceJa: 主導権は完全にあっち側、“魂のある使い魔の意識”にいってしまう
findings.governingReading: control passes completely to the other side, the consciousness of the ensouled familiar
findings.explanation: The controlling subject is reduced to an ambiguous plural pronoun.

findings.highlight: Moving your consciousness into a living thing
findings.evidenceJa: 『自分の意識』を移して支配する
findings.governingReading: moving one’s consciousness into an already living ensouled familiar and dominating it
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits domination and the familiar category from the act elevated to reincarnation.

findings.highlight: create an offspring with your soul in it
findings.evidenceJa: 自らの魂を受け継いだ子を生み出す
findings.governingReading: produce a child who inherits one’s own soul
findings.explanation: Inheritance across rebirth becomes physical containment of the prior soul.

findings.highlight: the soulless familiars used today
findings.evidenceJa: 現代の魔術師の作れる『魂のない使い魔』
findings.governingReading: soulless familiars that modern magi are capable of making
findings.explanation: A limit on contemporary creation is changed into a claim about current usage.

findings.highlight: controlling a doll filled with cotton
findings.evidenceJa: 中身がワタの人形を、遠くから魔力で操ってるだけ
findings.governingReading: merely controlling a cotton-stuffed doll from afar with magical energy
findings.explanation: Distance and magical energy, the reasons it is only a proxy, disappear.

findings.highlight: It’s not immortality
findings.evidenceJa: 術者が不老不死になれるわけではない
findings.governingReading: this cannot make the practitioner ageless and immortal
findings.explanation: The claim about what happens to the caster loses the explicit ageless component.

findings.highlight: The only eternal things in this physical world are souls
findings.evidenceJa: 永劫不滅なのは魂だけ
findings.governingReading: only the soul is eternally indestructible in the material world
findings.explanation: The categorical singular substance and indestructibility become plural “things” described merely as eternal.

findings.highlight: destined with ‘eventual death’
findings.evidenceJa: “有限の死”を宿命付けられてしまう
findings.governingReading: is fated to finite death
findings.explanation: Finitude imposed by embodiment becomes only the timing claim that death eventually occurs.

findings.highlight: The white girl asks me
findings.evidenceJa: 小さく、白い少女は問い掛けてきた
findings.governingReading: the white girl asks him softly or in a small voice
findings.explanation: Illya’s diminished, vulnerable delivery is omitted.

findings.highlight: You idiot
findings.evidenceJa: ……ばか
findings.governingReading: an inward, tender “idiot” directed at Illya
